QuestInfo.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
QuestInfo.1: I met #b#p603##k, a medicinal herb trader, in front of the #m10005001#. He appears to be the younger brother of #p602#. He recently discovered a place that grows the last herb he needs for a medicine he's been working on... He asked me to go deep in the forest and grab the #b#t4031025##k. It's made of green grass and a small pink flower... I need to make sure I get him the same exact one. #b#p306##k from #m10002000# can take me to the right place.
QuestInfo.2: Thankfully, I got the flower that #p603# wanted from the Forest of Patience, and, as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a #bscroll for overall armor#k. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay #p306# of #m10002000#. From what I've heard, the diet medicine #p603#'s working on is for #p306#'s fiance... I should go back to the Forest of Patience when I have some spare time...

0.0: Wait, hold on one second. I am an herb collector, traveling around the world looking for herbs. I'm looking for useful medicinal herbs around this area. It's been hard finding those these days... So, hey, have you found a place where the herbs run aplenty?
0.1: Actually, I did find a place where you can find good medicinal herbs. It's in a forest not too far from here... Lots of obstacles around the area, but I can tell that, in the end, there will be goods available for us to use... So what do you think? Would you go there in my place?

yes.0: Thank you. The place where you can find the mysterious herb is actually somewhere you've been before, #m10002000#. I heard you have to pay an entrance fee... You have the Mesos to go in, right? Sorry, but I've spent all my money traveling, so I'm afraid I can't help you with that...
yes.1: Yes! Let me explain more about the herb you'll be getting for me. There are similar herbs around, so make sure you remember this. The herb you'll need to get is a #b#t4031025##k, and the flower looks like this: #i4031025#. Look carefully and please get the exact one I described for you.

no.0: Really. You look like you'd just breeze through there... Please come back here when you have time. I'll be waiting for you.

1.0: Ohhh... This is IT! With this #b#t4031025##k, I can finally make the diet medicine!! Hahaha, if you ever feel like you have gained weight, feel free to find me; by then, I may have a special medicine for just that!
1.1: Oh, I almost forgot. Since you helped me out, I should thank you for your hard work. Here, take this scroll. My brother made this for me a while back, and it adds to the defensive abilities of overall armor. Hopefully you'll use it well. And from here on out, #p306# will let you in for free. Thanks for your help...

item.0: You haven't gotten the herb yet. The herb you need to get is #b#t4031025##k. The flower looks like this: #i4031025#. Remember it and get it from #p306# in #m10002000#.
